exposure: Remaining myometrial thickness of less than 3 mm
cohort: 38 symptomatic women with cesarean scar defects and remaining myometrial thickness of less than 3 mm
finding: Laparoscopic repair of cesarean scar defects in women with thin myometrium significantly increased myometrial thickness and resolved symptoms in most patients.
mod_finding: Among the 18 women with infertility, eight (44%) became pregnant and delivered healthy babies by cesarean section at 38-39 weeks of gestation after laparoscopic repair.
gest_age: 38-39 weeks (in those who conceived after surgery)
